title: Mortgage Assistance Plan for Retrenched Flat Owners
what_it_is: Mortgage Assistance Plan for Retrenched Flat Owners

sections.label: HDB help for flat owners
sections.summary: HDB offers flat owners financial counselling, referral to support agencies, mortgage instalment reduction or deferment, joint ownership, another loan, interim rental housing or a public rental flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As a first step, Housing Counsellors in HDB branches provide financial counselling and explore sustainable housing options with the flat owners, for example, by subletting their spare bedrooms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Housing Counsellors in the branches may also refer them to social support agencies for job placements and financial aid, for example, at the Employment and Employability Institute, Social Service Offices (SSOs) and Family Service Centres.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Flat owners who face short-term difficulties in servicing their mortgage instalments may be offered a temporary reduction or deferment of their mortgage instalments to help them with their cash flow situation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For those who face longer term difficulties and hardship, HDB will advise them on measures, such as including their working adult children as joint owners, to help with the mortgage instalments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In this situation, HDB may offer them another loan and/or interim rental housing to help with their move.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Page: 6 For low-income households who are unable to afford another flat, have no family support and no other housing options, HDB may offer them a public rental flat.

sections.label: HDB not a bank
sections.summary: HDB states it is not a bank and cannot offer personal loans to flat owners, though it can help restructure HDB mortgage loans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: HDB, however, is not a bank and is not able to offer personal loans to flat owners, although we can help them with restructuring their HDB mortgage loans.
